sources_checked.name: Wayback Machine CMC historical pages
sources_checked.notes: DIRECT ACCESS CONFIRMED. Full ranking tables (rank, name, symbol, market cap, price, circulating supply, volume) retrieved via Wayback snapshots of coinmarketcap.com/historical/<YYYYMMDD>/. No API key required. Captures confirmed at: 2019-12-31 (sha256 0ca492a4…, capture 2021-04-18T13:34:18Z), 2020-01-01 (sha256 90f8ceca…, capture 2021-01-02T05:52:18Z), 2020-01-19 (sha256 520b694b…, capture 2020-11-26T21:13:11Z), 2020-09-13 (sha256 c10348af…, capture 2020-12-04T09:08:11Z), 2022-01-01 (sha256 e2c52f63…, capture 2022-03-01T21:53:30Z), 2023-01-01 (sha256 385a5cde…, capture 2023-12-04T06:21:44Z), 2024-01-01 (sha256 79a88bd8…, capture 2026-05-21T10:48:15Z). CDX query for 2019-12-23, 2020-02-04, 2020-07-10, 2020-10-14 returned no captures (no historical page archived). Saved evidence pages under /tmp/pit_rank_evidence/. Defensible free PIT market-cap rank source at snapshot dates; coverage is snapshot-based, not continuous across every formation date.

sources_checked.name: GitHub scrapers/repos with CMC historical data
sources_checked.notes: Multiple repos exist (coinmarketcappy, scrape-cmc scripts) but they scrape live/historical pages; no committed bulk PIT rank datasets for 2019-2024 covering all candidates found in repo. Using them would require running scrapers which may hit rate limits/ToS concerns; not pre-existing data.

conclusion: Extended search (2026-10-24T23:59Z): Wayback Machine CMC historical pages confirmed directly accessible and contain full point-in-time ranking tables at snapshot dates (2019-12-31, 2020-01-01, 2020-09-13, 2022-01-01, 2023-01-01, 2024-01-01). Evidence pages saved under /tmp/pit_rank_evidence/ with sha256 checksums. This is a defensible free PIT market-cap rank source, but coverage is snapshot-based (not every formation date has a capture); 2019-12-23 and 2020-10-14 returned 404. rank_verified remains false pending full point-in-time coverage across all formation dates.
